Homework Review

Packages/Functions: 
- Tidyverse --> filter(), mutate(), select(), str_detect(), summarise(), group_by(), na.omit(), case_when(), left_join()
- Readr --> read_csv()
- Tmap --> tm_shape(), tm_polygon()
- Sf --> st_read(), st_transform()
- Janitor --> clean_names()

Process:
- Write out what the output you want

Read in data
Check column types in school report
Select - specific columns
Filter - county!=multiple, org level = school, tets subject = science, all grades

```{r}
# Example of EDA practice in examining all the variables and its variable class
Datatypelist <- report %>%
  summarise_all(class) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(),
               names_to="All_variables",
               values_to="Variable_class")

# Example of producing the cleaned up report in one command
county_only <- report %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  select (all the different columns, comma separated) %>%
  filter(this != not that) %>%
  filter (this == that) %>%
  filter (repeat as needed) %>%
  group_by(county)%>%
  na.omit() %>%
  summarise(new_column_name = sum(column_example),
            another_new_column_name = sum(column_example_2))

# Example of 
county_only_above_below_state <- data %>%
  mutate(different_to_state= percent_met) %>%
  mutate(case when this value > 0, then "above average"),
  mutate()

# always use the spatial data as the primary table
joined_data <- shape %>% 
  clean_names(.) %>%
  left_join(.,
            count_only_above_below_state,
            by = c("countylabe" = "county")) # <- best practice to not use the strings if possible


```


```{r}
#Load all the packages
library(sf)
library(tmaptools)
library(tmap)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidyr)
library(janitor)
```



```{r}
# Let's read and load the data first!
# na = "n/a"

SchoolReportCard <- read_csv("week2/Report_Card_Assessment_Data_2018-19_School_Year_20241008.csv", 
                         na = "n/a",
                         locale = locale(encoding = "latin1"))
```
```{r}
# Exploratory Data Analysis of the School Report Card CSV file
SchoolReportCard%>%
  colnames()
```
```{r}
SchoolReportCard%>%
  summarise(across(everything(), n_distinct))
```
```{r}
# Exploratory data analysis to assess column names and unique values
SchoolReportCard %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ paste(sort(unique(na.omit(.x))), collapse = " | "))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "column", values_to = "unique_values")
```

```{r}
SchoolReportCard_Science <- SchoolReportCard %>%
  filter(str_detect(`TestSubject`, "Science"))
```

```{r}
SchoolReportCard_Science2 <- SchoolReportCard %>%
  filter(str_detect(`TestSubject`, "Science")) %>%
  filter(str_detect(`GradeLevel`, "All Grades"))
```

```{r}
SchoolReportCard_Science3 <- SchoolReportCard %>%
  filter(str_detect(`TestSubject`, "Science")) %>%
  filter(str_detect(`GradeLevel`, "All Grades")) %>%
  filter(str_detect(`StudentGroup`, "All Students"))
```

```{r}
SchoolReportCard_Science3 <- SchoolReportCard_Science3 %>%
  clean_names()
```

```{r}
SchoolReportCard_Science4 <- SchoolReportCard_Science3 %>%
  filter(str_detect(`test_administration_group`,"WCAS"))
```

```{r}
SchoolReportCard_Science5 <- SchoolReportCard_Science4 %>%
  filter(str_detect(`organization_level`,"District|State"))
```

```{r}
glimpse(SchoolReportCard_Science5)
```
```{r}
SchoolReportCard_Science6 <- SchoolReportCard_Science5 %>%
  mutate(across(c(count_of_students_expected_to_test,count_met_standard),
                as.numeric))
```
```{r}
glimpse(SchoolReportCard_Science6)
```

```{r}
SchoolScience <- SchoolReportCard_Science6 %>%
  mutate(percent_meeting_standard= (count_met_standard/count_of_students_expected_to_test)) %>%
  dplyr::select(organization_level,
        county,
        district_name,
        school_name,
        student_group_type, 
        student_group,
        grade_level,
        test_administration_group,
        test_subject,
        count_of_students_expected_to_test,
        count_met_standard,
        percent_meeting_standard) %>%
  arrange(percent_meeting_standard)
```

```{r}
SchoolScience3 <- SchoolScience %>%
  filter(organization_level == "District") %>%
  mutate(percent_meeting_standard = percent_meeting_standard * 100)
```

```{r}
SchoolScience4 <- SchoolScience3 %>%
  mutate(PercentDiff = percent_meeting_standard-46.67) %>%
  mutate(across(is.numeric, round, 3))
```
```{r}
SchoolScience_group <- SchoolScience4 %>%
  group_by(county) %>%
  summarise(
    total_students_testing = sum(count_of_students_expected_to_test, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_met_standard = sum(count_met_standard, na.rm = TRUE),
    percent_met_standard = round(((total_met_standard / total_students_testing)*100), 3),
    percent_diff = percent_met_standard - 46.67
  ) %>%
  arrange(percent_diff)

SchoolScience_group
```


```{r}
washington_boundaries <- st_read("week2/boundaries/Washington_Counties_with_Natural_Shoreline___washsh_area.shp")
```
```{r}
summary(washington_boundaries)
```
```{r}
plot(washington_boundaries)
```

```{r}
CountyDataMap <- washington_boundaries %>%
  left_join(.,
        SchoolScience_group, 
        by = c("COUNTYLABE" = "county"))
```

```{r}
qtm(CountyDataMap,
    fill = "percent_diff")
```
```{r}
tmap_county <- CountyDataMap %>%
  st_bbox(.) %>%
  tmaptools::read_osm(., type = "esri", zoom = NULL)
```

```{r}
tmap_mode("plot")

tm_shape(tmap_county)+
  tm_rgb()+
  tm_shape(CountyDataMap)+
  tm_polygons(fill="percent_diff",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(values="brewer.bu_pu",
                                              style="jenks"),
                                              fill_alpha=0.5,
              fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Percent difference from state average",
                                      size = 0.8))+
  tm_compass(type="arrow", position = c("left", "bottom")) +
  tm_scalebar(position = c("left", "bottom"))+
  tm_title("Percentage difference of Student Science Grades compared to the State Average",
           size = 2,
           position = c("center","top"))
```
```{r}
CountyDataMap84 <- CountyDataMap %>%
  st_transform(.,4326)

tmap_mode("view")
```
```{r}
tm_shape(CountyDataMap84) + 
  # add polygon layer
  tm_polygons(fill="percent_diff",
              fill.scale= tm_scale_intervals(values="brewer.rd_yl_gn",
                                              # midpoint = 0
                                              style  = "fixed",
                                              breaks = seq(-25, 25, by = 5)     
                                              ),
                                              fill_alpha=0.8,
              fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Percent diff from State Average", 
                                      size = 0.8))+
  tm_basemap(server = "OpenStreetMap") +
  tm_compass(type = "arrow", position = c("left", "bottom")) + 
  tm_scalebar(position = c("left", "bottom"))+
  tm_title("Percent diff of Science Student Grades compared to State Average", 
            size = 2,
            position = c("center", "top"))
```
